name: Stable Diffusion 3.5
description: Open-weight image generation model with fine control over outputs.
longDescription: Stable Diffusion 3.5 is Stability AI's latest open-weight image generation model using a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer architecture. It offers three variants (Large, Large Turbo, and Medium) for different quality/speed tradeoffs, with improved text rendering and prompt adherence.
limitations: Safety filters may be too strict

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.stability.ai/v2beta/stable-image/generate/sd3",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer $STABILITY_API_KEY"},
    files={"none": ""},
    data={"prompt": "A futuristic cityscape", "model": "sd3.5-large"}
)
with open("output.png", "wb") as f:
    f.write(response.content)
